plain_text_formula: CVD=1 if any observed component is yes; CVD=0 if no observed component is yes and at least one component is observed.
mathematical_expression: I(any observed MCQ160B-F == 1); otherwise 0 when at least one is observed
handling_rule: All-five-missing records are excluded; a strict sensitivity requires all five components observed and negative for noncase status; outcome components never enter predictors.

plain_text_formula: Use LBXTR in 2005-2018; convert 2021-2023 LBXTLG to old LBXTR scale using CDC backward equation.
handling_rule: Values <=0 invalid for TyG; fasting subsample required.

plain_text_formula: Natural log of triglycerides times fasting glucose divided by 2.
TyG index multiplied by waist circumference.
handling_rule: Fasting-core sample; no outcome-driven cutoff selection.

plain_text_formula: Systemic inflammation response index from absolute neutrophil, monocyte, and lymphocyte counts.
handling_rule: Require lymphocyte_abs>0; use absolute counts; if absolute count missing, derive from WBC and percentages only as documented.

plain_text_formula: CKD-EPI 2021 race-free creatinine equation, matching original project code.
handling_rule: Require Scr>0, age non-missing, sex non-missing; no race coefficient.

plain_text_formula: Use NHANES direct URDACT where available; otherwise calculate urine albumin divided by urine creatinine times 100.
handling_rule: Use reported NHANES values including LLOD/sqrt(2) fill values; log2 transform only if UACR>0.
